newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit in range, but seen down on dlr strength.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit in range, but seen down on dlr strength.

text.p: The ringgit was rangebound in late Kuala Lumpur, but was expected to decline slightly on the strength of the dollar, dealers said.
They said volumes were down sharply as the market was waiting for a crucial U.S. monetary policy meeting meeting tonight, which is expected to discuss possible credit tightening.
Many expect the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee to raise interest rates by 25 basis points.
"The market is divided over the rate hike possiblity. It is a wait-and-watch situation," a foreign exchange dealer said.
